solves.reasoning: 본문: teaching a dog to perform → (A)=perform. signals may be verbal or non-verbal → (B)=verbal. spoken word can be eliminated → (C)=eliminated. ①번.
dealing with a series of obstacles or barriers → (A)=obstacles. a combination of the two → (B)=combination. imperceptible to the human audience → (C)=imperceptible. ②번.
signal from the handler → (A)=handler. an accompanying hand signal → (B)=accompanying. so expertly trained → (C)=expertly. ④번.
원문 'as complex as retrieving' → ③ simple이 complex 자리에 들어가 부적절.
원문 'verbal or non-verbal' → ① physical이 verbal 자리에 들어가 대비 구조 깨짐.
원문 'imperceptible to the human audience' → ③ noticeable은 반의어로 맥락 충돌.
a series of ____ or barriers → obstacles. barriers와 병렬되는 장애물 의미.
the spoken word can be ____ → eliminated. 비언어 전환 흐름에서 구두 명령 제거.
an ____ hand signal → accompanying. 명령에 동반하는 손 신호.
handler = trainer. 동물 조련사 = 훈련시키는 사람.
retrieving(회수하는) ≈ recover(되찾다). 물건을 가져오는 행위의 동의어.
imperceptible(감지 불가) ≈ undetectable(탐지 불가). 동일 의미.
complex(복잡한) ↔ straightforward(단순한). 나머지는 유사어.
slight(사소한) ↔ substantial(상당한). tiny/minor/subtle은 유사 방향.
(A) a command of languages = 구사력/능숙함. (B) verbal command = 명령/지시. 의미 다름.
inexperienced in a task = novice(초보자). handler/expert/barrier 모두 불일치.
an ____ (accompany) hand signal → 명사 앞 현재분사형 형용사. accompanying.
may be ____ (perception) → be + 형용사. im- + percept + -ible = imperceptible.
imperceptible to humans but easily ____ → picked up by the trained dog. but 대비.
respond to ____ → a verbal command and an accompanying hand signal. 뒤에 Later로 전환 설명.
